entries.task_id: who wields|the|many kinds of psychic power: multiplying themselves and becoming one again
entries.description: who wields the many kinds of psychic power: multiplying themselves and becoming one again
entries.subject: who wields
entries.object: many kinds of psychic power: multiplying themselves and becoming one again

spans.text: It’s a mendicant who wields the many kinds of psychic power: multiplying themselves and becoming one again; materializing and dematerializing; going unobstructed through a wall, a rampart, or a mountain as if through space; diving in and out of the earth as if it were water; walking on water as if it were earth; flying cross-legged through the sky like a bird; touching and stroking with the hand the sun and moon, so mighty and powerful; controlling the body as far as the realm of divinity.
